pain_point: Fear of buying at the wrong time - What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?
headline_outcome: Your Rent Went Up. Prices Did Too.
primary_text: "What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?" Business owners asked this same question two years ago. Since then, rents have risen 15–20% across Melbourne's west and industrial land prices have followed. Waiting didn't save them money — it cost them. Off-the-plan means you fix your purchase price today. Settlement happens when the build completes. That gap gives the rate cycle time to shift in your favour. Truganina warehouses are designed for owner-occupiers who are done watching from the sidelines. Limited stock in this release. Prices won't stay here forever.
description: Industrial rents in Melbourne's west have risen 15-20% in two years
